scope: Disposable identities, synthetic reserve roots, real P-256/AES-GCM, local SQLite and two loopback HTTP carriers. No chain calls, funding, wallet changes or physical-device tests.

mutations.name: disclosure
failedTests: missing, private-only and changed disclosure consent cannot silently use public execution
an authenticated carrier packet cannot bypass action or disclosure validation at intake

mutations.name: executor
failedTests: an authenticated carrier packet cannot bypass action or disclosure validation at intake

mutations.name: owner
failedTests: changed owner, executor, network, target, amounts, receiver, signatures and ancestry are rejected

mutations.name: signature
failedTests: changed owner, executor, network, target, amounts, receiver, signatures and ancestry are rejected
outer authorization signature and id are checked independently of the encrypted packet

mutations.name: expiry
failedTests: request lifetime and signed swap deadline bound acceptance, including authenticated changes

mutations.name: refund-payer
failedTests: refund-return binds its payer, source, amount, reserve and original owner without claiming a refund exists

mutations.name: conflict-slot
failedTests: different signed authorizations for the same input conflict even after the old request expires
a second messaging identity using the same spending key cannot bypass input conflicts, including older records

mutations.name: capacity
failedTests: global, byte and per-sender quotas reject without evicting existing requests

mutations.name: late-expiry
failedTests: expiry during verification, a forged envelope and a closed database cannot produce storage receipts

mutations.name: receipt-state
failedTests: storage receipts reject fake settlement, another request, extra fields and a foreign signer

mutations.name: spending-authority
failedTests: a second messaging identity using the same spending key cannot bypass input conflicts, including older records

mutations.name: legacy-conflicts
failedTests: a second messaging identity using the same spending key cannot bypass input conflicts, including older records

mutations.name: input-snapshot
failedTests: validation snapshots mutable input before its first asynchronous check
